template.description: Rule set to start from: `interview`, `podcast-calm` or `panel-dynamic`. Default `interview`.

minShot.description: Shortest shot: a shorter one (a quick interjection) merges into the shot before it, so the voice plays over that picture. Seconds.

maxShot.description: Longest solo, seconds: a solo held longer gets a cutaway (see `cutaway`) every this many seconds. Null switches the rule off.

cutLead.description: J-cut: the new speaker's voice leads the picture by this long, so a cut to a speaker lands this far into their turn. 0 cuts on the first word. Seconds.

anyOf.description: Quick exchange: three or more turns in a row alternating between the same two people, each shorter than this, become one two-up. Null switches the rule off. Seconds.
Two people talking at once for at least this long get a two-up; shorter overlaps keep the shot that was on. Null switches the rule off. Seconds.
Nobody speaking for at least this long goes wide; shorter pauses keep the shot that was on. Null switches the rule off. Seconds.
Laughter or cross-talk: `together` or more people talking at once for at least this long goes wide (shorter: two-up rules apply). Null switches the rule off. Seconds.

together.description: People talking at once that count as laughter; capped at the group's angles with a picture, so everyone in a group of two.

to.description: `listener`: a solo of the listener with the highest weight (a reaction shot); `wide`: a grid of every angle.

length.description: Seconds the cutaway lasts before the picture returns to the speaker.

weights.description: Weight per angle id, default 1: who the picture favours when the rules must pick (the two-up pair among more people talking at once, the listener of a cutaway). 0: never shown alone or in a two-up (wide shots still show them); their turns keep the shot that was on.
